corrected_code:
from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from fastapi_limiter.depends import RateLimiter

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v2/analytics")

async def verified_partner_rate_key(request: Request) -> str:
    partner: PartnerProfile = request.state.current_partner
    return f"partner_export_limit:{partner.id}"

@router.get(
    "/exports/partners/{partner_license_key}",
    dependencies=[Depends(RateLimiter(times=10, seconds=3600, identifier=verified_partner_rate_key))]
)
async def download_partner_bulk_export(
    partner_license_key: str,
    export_service: PartnerExportService = Depends(get_partner_export_service),
    current_partner: PartnerProfile = Depends(get_current_partner_profile)
):
    license_record = await export_service.get_license(partner_license_key)
    if not license_record:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Partner license not found")
    if license_record.partner_id != current_partner.id and not current_partner.is_global_admin:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: unauthorized to access export archive for this partner license")

    export_archive = await export_service.generate_partner_archive(license_record.partner_id)
    return {
        "partner_id": license_record.partner_id,
        "download_url": export_archive.presigned_s3_url,
        "record_count": export_archive.record_count
    }
